key.query: What studies compare adenoma detection rates between MiraLAX and Golytely?

evidence.title: PubMed 22084361 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: A separate metaanalysis of nearly 3,000 patients with a history of colorectal adenoma or cancer in four randomized adenoma prevention trials showed that aspirin reduced the occurrence of advanced adenomas by 28% and any adenoma by 17%.

evidence.title: PubMed 2803131 [sections.0]
evidence.cited_text: Patients with pituitary adenoma had a significantly higher (p less than 0.001) baseline serum prolactin level (182 +/- 4.6 ng/ml) than those with no adenoma (59.2 +/- 4.2 ng/ml). All patients in the study were treated with bromocriptine (2.5-10 mg) to normalize serum prolactin or to achieve a pregnancy.

evidence.title: PubMed 9166168 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: Initial and revised screen-positive rates and detection rates were reviewed for women undergoing triple-marker testing (maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, and unconjugated estriol).
